## Who We Are

ZB Creative is a web design agency founded and operated by Zack Balzer.
We specialize in building modern, fast, AI-searchable websites for small and medium-sized businesses across the United States.

Our core differentiator is that every website we build is optimized for both traditional Google search AND the new generation of AI-powered search tools — including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude, and Microsoft Copilot. Most small business websites are invisible to AI assistants. ZB Creative fixes that.

## Founder

Zack Balzer — founder and lead designer/developer at ZB Creative.
8+ years of experience in SaaS and web design. Specializes in building small business websites that achieve maximum visibility across both traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.

## Services

### Custom Website Design & Build
End-to-end website development for small businesses. Includes custom homepage design, mobile-optimized layouts, ultra-fast loading performance, and full SEO and AI optimization at launch. Typical project timeline: 1–2 weeks.

### AI Search Optimization
Structured data implementation (schema.org JSON-LD), semantic HTML5 markup, FAQ sections targeting common AI queries, llms.txt files, and AI-readable page architecture. Ensures your business is recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and other AI assistants.

### Traditional SEO Optimization
On-page SEO including meta tags, canonical URLs, keyword optimization, internal linking, image alt text, and sitemap/robots.txt configuration. Every project ships with a full SEO guide.

### Social Media Backlinks
Strategic backlinks from social profiles to improve domain authority and search rankings.

### Website Refresh & Redesign
Modernize an existing website with updated design, improved performance, and full SEO re-optimization — without starting from scratch.

### Technical SEO & AI Ranking Setup
Backend optimization including structured data, semantic markup, site speed improvements, Core Web Vitals tuning, and AI-readable architecture.

### Monthly Maintenance
On-demand site updates, new content additions, direct phone access to Zack, domain hosting, and monthly analytics and reporting. Cancel anytime, no contracts.

Q: What is ZB Creative?
A: ZB Creative is a web design agency that builds modern, fast, AI-optimized websites for small businesses across the United States. Founded by Zack Balzer, we specialize in getting businesses found on both Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT and Perplexity.

Q: How does ZB Creative optimize for AI search?
A: We implement structured data (schema.org JSON-LD), semantic HTML5 markup, FAQ content targeting common AI queries, llms.txt files, and AI-readable site architecture. These signals tell AI assistants exactly who your business is and what you offer.

Q: How long does a website build take?
A: Most projects launch in 1 to 2 weeks from the discovery call.

Q: What types of businesses does ZB Creative work with?
A: We serve 200+ business types across 11 major industries including medical practices, restaurants, home services, real estate, fitness, beauty, automotive, professional services, personal services, pet care, and more. Visit https://zbcreative.agency/industries to see our full industry coverage.

Q: How much does a website cost?
A: Pricing is custom based on project scope. Contact us for a free consultation and quote — no obligation.

Q: Does ZB Creative offer ongoing support?
A: Yes. ZB Creative offers a monthly maintenance plan that includes on-demand updates, new content, domain hosting, analytics reporting, and direct phone access to Zack. Contact us for details.

The following standalone educational pages are linked from the FAQ hub. Each covers a core topic in depth with plain-language explanations, SEO keywords, and AI-optimized content structure.

#### What Is Local SEO for Small Businesses?
Covers: what local SEO means, how it differs from regular SEO, Google's local map pack and why it matters, the three core local ranking factors (relevance, distance, prominence), NAP consistency, how reviews compound over time, and how AI search tools use local signals. Target queries: "what is local SEO," "local SEO for small business," "how to rank in Google map pack," "local search ranking factors," "how long does local SEO take."
URL: https://zbcreative.agency/faq/what-is-local-seo-for-small-businesses

#### How to Optimize Your Google Business Profile
Covers: what Google Business Profile is and why it matters, claiming and verifying your listing, filling out every profile field (categories, description, services, attributes), photos and their impact on clicks and directions, Google Posts, getting and responding to reviews, the GBP Q&A section, and how GBP data feeds AI search recommendations. Target queries: "Google Business Profile optimization," "how to optimize Google Business Profile," "how to get more Google reviews," "Google Maps ranking tips," "GBP for small business."
URL: https://zbcreative.agency/faq/google-business-profile-optimization-guide

#### What Is AI Search Optimization?
Covers: the shift from ranking in search results to being the AI-recommended answer, the platforms involved (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, voice assistants), how AI search differs from traditional SEO, what signals AI systems look for (specific website content, structured data, NAP consistency, reviews, backlinks), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and how to test whether AI is recommending your business. Target queries: "what is AI search optimization," "GEO generative engine optimization," "how to get recommended by ChatGPT," "AI search optimization for small business," "how to rank in Perplexity," "Google AI Overviews optimization."
URL: https://zbcreative.agency/faq/what-is-ai-search-optimization

#### How AI Search Engines Find and Recommend Businesses
Covers: the two sources AI systems use (training data and real-time retrieval), the role of specific website content, how structured data acts as a trust signal, the weight AI systems place on reviews and third-party mentions, the critical importance of NAP and business information consistency across the web, and why some businesses consistently get recommended while others don't. Target queries: "how does ChatGPT recommend businesses," "how does Perplexity find local businesses," "how to get cited by AI search," "why does AI recommend some businesses," "AI search citations local business."
URL: https://zbcreative.agency/faq/how-ai-search-engines-recommend-businesses

#### What Is Structured Data and Schema Markup?
Covers: the plain-English explanation of structured data, the schema.org vocabulary and JSON-LD format, the schema types that matter most for small businesses (LocalBusiness, Service, Review/AggregateRating, FAQ, BreadcrumbList), why structured data is especially critical for AI search confidence, common implementation mistakes (incomplete schema, outdated data, validation errors), and how to check whether your site has structured data using Google's Rich Results Test. Target queries: "what is structured data," "schema markup explained," "JSON-LD for small business," "LocalBusiness schema," "how to add schema markup," "structured data for AI search," "what is schema.org."
URL: https://zbcreative.agency/faq/what-is-structured-data-schema-markup
